_comment: EXAMPLE cron jobs — create these via OpenClaw's cron tooling/dashboard in your version (verbs evolve; check `openclaw --help` / docs.openclaw.ai). Payloads must be self-sufficient. Times: set your VM timezone deliberately.

jobs.name: vm-readiness-daily
jobs.payload: Run the sysadmin-check skill. Send the full readiness report to my Telegram. Log it to today's memory note. Read-only: propose fixes, never run them.

jobs.name: weekday-morning-brief
jobs.payload: Run the daily-brief skill for topics in USER.md (last 24h, dedupe vs yesterday's brief in memory notes, max 7 items, under 200 words, cite everything). Send to my Telegram. Quiet day: send exactly 'Quiet morning — nothing needs you.'

jobs.name: job-search-mwf
jobs.payload: Run the job-search skill against USER.md criteria. Dedupe via memory/job-search-log.md and update it. Shortlist max 5 with Why-you and Watch lines. Never auto-apply. Send to my Telegram.

jobs.name: weekly-business-report
jobs.payload: Using the research-report skill's discipline and this week's memory notes plus any files in workspace/metrics/, write reports/weekly-<date>.md (wins / numbers / blockers / next week, unknowns labelled). Send me a 5-line summary + file path on Telegram. Draft only — do not send to anyone else.
